clean_bathroom.description: Clean the grimy bathroom: spray then scrub basin and bath.
clean_bathroom.notes: Pick up spray once only (falls happened when picking it up repeatedly); put it on floor before taking the brush. Each use rubs 5 s; the bath needed about 8 to 10 rubs in total. Repeat use bath/basin and inspect until 0 patches remain. If cleaner dries, re-spray. Took about 280 s.

lessons: I fell while doing pick_up {"object": "spray"} (during: The bathroom is grimy - please clean it.). Avoid that, or do it another way.
